title: voidhash.json
description: The Voidhash configuration of a directory: the project an app is built for, and the type files generated for it.

team.description: The slug of the organization that owns the project.

types.description: The type files 'voidhash types generate' writes. Without it, one TypeScript declaration file is written to voidhash.gen.d.ts.

output.description: The file's path, relative to this file.

package.description: Kotlin only: the package the file declares. Without it, the package follows from the path below a java or kotlin source directory.

typesOutput.description: Deprecated: the path of the TypeScript declaration file. Use a "types" entry instead.
